persona_label: Para-rower with SCI — time travel to 2036 Games

conversation_log.content:
To help understand your unique physical identity, how would you best describe your primary relationship with training and movement over the last decade?
Options: [A dedicated pursuit of raw power, explosive speed, and strength-based performance. | A focus on sustained endurance, metabolic efficiency, and long-term cardiovascular health. | A commitment to precision, complex coordination, and technical skill mastery.]
A commitment to precision, complex coordination, and technical skill mastery.

When you are in the middle of a high-stakes performance, which aspect of the environment tends to drive your focus the most?
Options: [The silent, singular pursuit of internal mastery against a technical benchmark. | The dynamic, high-pressure interaction of reading and responding to an opponent's moves. | The collaborative synchronization of a team working toward a complex tactical objective.]
The silent, singular pursuit of internal mastery against a technical benchmark.

At this point in your legacy, having refined your craft over decades, how does your focus on technical mastery manifest when you are preparing for a defining moment at the 2036 Games?
Options: [Focusing on refining a singular, signature movement to its absolute, timeless peak. | Pivoting my established technical expertise into a more complex, tactical competitive discipline. | Mentoring others while utilizing my own technical precision to maintain high-performance efficiency.]
Focusing on refining a singular, signature movement to its absolute, timeless peak.

Your 184cm, 88kg frame provides a uniquely balanced foundation that allows you to approach the Decathlon not merely as a test of endurance, but as a laboratory for the perfect, signature movement. While many see the multi-discipline pathway as a scramble for points, you view it as ten separate opportunities to exhibit your life’s work in precision.

Your deep technical mastery transforms the inherent strain of this archetype into a structured, meditative process. By focusing on the absolute, timeless peak of each discipline, you demonstrate that athletic longevity is the byproduct of discipline rather than raw youth. At The 2036 Games, you will be the practitioner who proves that even in the most grueling environments, a singular, obsessive focus on the mechanics of movement is the ultimate competitive advantage.

scouting_result.scout_verdict:
The Launch Force archetype offers a stark, powerful contrast to your endurance-focused goals. Here, the focus shifts away from the rhythmic sequence of movement toward the singular, explosive physics of the release. Your 88kg frame acts as a grounded, kinetic anchor, making you a master of the seated throw. In this discipline, your life-long dedication to precision is redirected into the management of force and leverage, where the smallest adjustment to your position at the point of release determines the trajectory of the implement.

At The 2036 Games, this archetype allows you to harness your grounded physical presence as a weapon of sheer intent. You have pivoted from the complexity of multi-discipline movement to the concentrated mastery of a single, definitive action. This path demands a cold, internal focus on internal benchmarks, turning your years of experience into a display of absolute stability and explosive impact that contrasts sharply with the broader, sweeping nature of your other athletic pursuits.

eval_result.summary: While the narrative effectively adopts a legacy tone and heavily personalizes the text based on interview answers, the archetype matching is fundamentally flawed and contradicts the user's choices.

authenticity.reasoning: Recommending Decathlon (a 10-event sport) to a user who explicitly selected 'focusing on refining a singular, signature movement' is a massive contradiction, and elite Decathlon at age 48 is highly unrealistic.

personalization.reasoning: The verdicts explicitly weave in the user's exact interview selections, such as pursuing a 'singular, signature movement' and focusing on 'internal mastery against a technical benchmark'.

distinctness.reasoning: The second scout verdict completely ignores the standing pathway (Bobsleigh) and exclusively writes the narrative about the adaptive pathway (Seated Throws).

life_stage_coherence.reasoning: Target age 48 (Legacy); the narrative correctly adopts a tone of 'athletic longevity' and discipline, but assigning the grueling 10-event Decathlon contradicts realistic life-stage athletic capacity.

interview_quality.reasoning: The questions feature a strong logical progression, moving from general movement philosophy to specific legacy applications with meaningfully distinct options.
